Container.Name: allthemods10-tts
Container.Overview:
A Modded Java Minecraft server container for Unraid that runs All the Mods 10: To the Sky (ATM10SKY).
Persistent Custom Mods & Configs (Survives Updates): - Extra Mods: Drop .jar files into /data/custom_mods - Custom Configs: Drop config files into /data/custom_config
Recommended Server RAM (JVM_OPTS): - Minimum (1-3 players): 6-8 GB (-Xms6144m -Xmx8192m) - Recommended (2-5 players): 8-10 GB (-Xms8192m -Xmx10240m) - Heavy / 5+ players: 12-16 GB (-Xms10240m -Xmx16384m)
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: minecraft allthemods10 atm10 allthemods10tts atm10sky atm tts

Config.Name: Installed Location
Config.Description: Path to store the installed server files.

Config.Name: EULA
Config.Description: Do you agree to the Mojang EULA available at https://account.mojang.com/documents/minecraft_eula? Server will not start without accepting. Set to 'true' to accept.

Config.Name: JVM_OPTS
Config.Description: JAVA Options Performance Tip: Allocate at least 6-8 GB of RAM for 1-3 players, 8-10 GB for 2-5 players, or 12-16 GB for 5+ players.

Config.Name: WHITELIST_USERS
Config.Description: Add Users comma-separated to the Whitelist. Example Value: TestUserName1, TestUserName2

Config.Name: OP_USERS
Config.Description: Add Users comma-separated to grant Operator status. Example Value: TestUserName1, TestUserName2
